label: FPGA-C
title: fp_scalar multi-cycle/blocked FDIV implementation
scope: Replace >64-bit lpm_divide and non-viable 256-bit combinational division in fp_scalar with a multi-cycle blocked/iterative divider while preserving FP raw-bit semantics.

runs.command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- make VERILATOR_JOBS=1 sim-sv-fp-scalar
runs.summary: P7-1 FP scalar raw-bit directed SV TB passed with multi-cycle FDIV.

runs.command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- make VERILATOR_JOBS=1 sim-sv-p7-4-fma-convert
runs.summary: P7-4 scalar and NEON FMA/conversion raw-bit SV TBs passed.

runs.command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- make VERILATOR_JOBS=1 sim-sv-p7-5-fp16-sqrt-minmax-round
runs.summary: P7-5 scalar FP16/sqrt/minmax/frint/fcvt and NEON FP16 raw-bit SV TBs passed.

runs.command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- make VERILATOR_JOBS=1 compile
runs.summary: make compile -Wall core lint passed after the multi-cycle FDIV integration.

runs.command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- make VERILATOR_JOBS=1 sim-sv
runs.summary: lcvex_core_tb scalar + FPCR/FPSR wiring smoke passed with the modified EX stall path.

runs.command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- make VERILATOR_JOBS=1 sim-cocotb-fp-scalar
runs.summary: P7-1 Cocotb scalar FP pipeline 5/5 passed, including FDIV 2/1 through the real core.

known_limits: Not run: Quartus full flow/STA, board flow, QEMU strict lockstep, Gate D/L3.
FDIV latency is fixed at 256 cycles; no dynamic leading-bit shortening or higher-radix optimization yet.
FP16 uses two divider instances in parallel for low/high lanes; area impact not measured on Quartus.
lcvex_fp_divider is in the same file as lcvex_fp_scalar and uses a lint_off for DECLFILENAME; no filelist change was made.
next: Integrator reviews; rerun verification on merge SHA; optionally run Quartus standalone synthesis to confirm lpm_divide>64 is gone and measure area/timing.

integrator_review.notes: FPGA-C merged. Integrator reran make compile PASS, make sim-sv PASS, sim-sv-fp-scalar PASS under cgroup <16GiB. Multi-cycle 256-bit restoring divider avoids lpm_divide >64.
